tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineYiddish: דער קלוגער כתב-איבערקוקער פאר שיעורים און חידושי תורה
releaseTitle: v1.0.0 - Initial Release: Offline Hebrew Handwriting OCR & Memory Engine
description: IbberKuck is a fully offline, standalone desktop application designed specifically for yeshiva students, rebbeim, and scholars to transcribe handwritten Hebrew notes (cursive and print), proofread side-by-side with the original image, and export polished Word (.docx) documents. It features a self-learning memory engine that automatically learns from corrected mistakes to improve accuracy on every future scan.
features: 100% Offline OCR: Recognizes Hebrew cursive handwriting on standard CPU without internet.
Multi-Image Support: Attach single or multiple pages of notes, reorder, or batch-scan.
Side-by-Side Review: Smooth pan, zoom, and 90-degree rotate alongside a real-time Hebrew RTL editor.
Self-Learning Memory: Automatically identifies and remembers your corrections for all future scans.
Preloaded Yeshiva Lexicon: Built-in knowledge of common Talmudic abbreviations (Roshei Teivot) and terms.
Word Document Export: Generates clean, right-to-left formatted Microsoft Word (.docx) files ready for printing or sharing.
